name: asafmor-plugins
description: Asaf Mor's marketplace of Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: One-command onboarding that sets up graphify offline code indexing on a repo — indexes code into a queryable knowledge graph coding agents use for smart retrieval instead of grepping.

plugins.name: travel
plugins.description: Deep research for named trails, treks, hikes, and routes, producing comprehensive, current, source-backed planning reports.

plugins.name: visuals
plugins.description: Visual media for coding agents: generate posters, social posts and web/game assets with the Codex CLI, and build trailers, promos and social clips with Remotion.

plugins.name: review-tools
plugins.description: Code review for coding agents: run OpenCodeReview (ocr) with the right mode and flags, then triage its findings into fixes and reasoned rejections.
